meta.name: Eternally Confused and Eager for Love
meta.description: Often (mis)guided by a cheeky imaginary wizard, an awkward and lonely 20-something struggles to get out of his own way in his quest for a girlfriend.

videos.title: Origin Story
videos.overview: To save face, Ray lies about a big life event, but his friends react unexpectedly. A date set up by his mother holds promise, unless nerves take over.

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: Ray chooses not to look up photos of a date before he meets her — a decision that leads him to take a hard look in the mirror at his own reflection.

videos.title: Stag Entry
videos.overview: Ray panics over a looming dinner at Pari’s, but when plans change, he faces an even scarier night: a club, dancing and a girl who takes interest in him.

videos.title: Second Chance
videos.overview: When an opportunity for another shot with Pari has Ray newly optimistic, advice for how not to mess it up comes from an unlikely source.

videos.title: Foolproof
videos.overview: Ray wavers between pursuing Ruchika and telling Pari a dreaded truth. Meanwhile, a flawed plan reveals he still has lots to understand about women.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Mortified after the previous night, Ray indulges in some alone time, finally responds to Ruchika and has some awkward encounters at a house party.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: With his job and personal life tanking, Ray looks to an unexpected online match for cheering up, and tries a new approach on his date with Ruchika.

videos.title: Ray + Who? = Love
videos.overview: Before Varun’s engagement party, Ray mends a burned bridge. But at the event, fragile hope, loneliness and several drinks may add up to trouble.
